_readme: Single source of archetype × motion matrix (M2). `scroll` REQUIRED pattern(s); `enterPreferred` takes precedence during assignment (soft preference, door gives warning). Assignment: kit/assign-motion.mjs · gate: kit/motion-check.mjs.

sticky.why: The meaning of the sticky narrative is revealed by scrolling; Sticky hero would be wasted without pin/scrub.

index.why: The grill should be opened gradually; The single block fade kills the grid idea.

type.why: Poster typography should come line by line/letter; box fade flattens typography.

product.why: The giant panel must feel 'scale-settle', otherwise the card just appears.

fullbleed.why: Media should be opened/layered from the edge; Screen is natural for full edge media.

centered.why: Calm single message: no understated lift or soft blur.

split.why: Balanced default; Two columns may come from different directions.

split-reverse.why: Reverse flow breaks the rhythm; Sliding from both arms is the natural movement of this archetype.
